requirements.title: Authority is explicit and one-way
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every listed artifact has exactly one authority and conformance is derived exclusively from normative artifacts.

requirements.title: Version identity is stable
requirements.acceptance_gate: Series, release version, lifecycle state, validator version, normative digest, and conformance-pack digest are explicit and version-bound.

requirements.title: Released content is immutable
requirements.acceptance_gate: In-place release mutation and downgrade are denied; a change requires a strictly greater version, new path, and unchanged observed source digest.

requirements.title: Requirement identifiers are unique and permanent
requirements.acceptance_gate: Requirement identifiers match the shared stable format; amendments compare bound catalogs and exactly mark changed and new identifiers without removal or reassignment.

requirements.title: Vocabulary is canonical
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every named canonical term resolves to CONTEXT.md and no avoided synonym is accepted.

requirements.title: Structured contracts are closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Draft 2020-12 schemas reject unknown fields, enforce identifier and digest boundaries, and terminate within explicit evaluation and error budgets.

requirements.title: Lifecycle tables are complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Each state-command pair occurs exactly once with all required transition fields and denied-row coverage.

requirements.title: Traceability is stable and total
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every normative requirement has one resolving traceability record and every reference resolves.

requirements.title: Conformance observes public effects
requirements.acceptance_gate: Required fixtures bind observable lifecycle state and command evidence, while release assets bind specification and conformance-pack digests, validator version, independently reproduced validation, and traceability reports.

requirements.title: Package layout is declared
requirements.acceptance_gate: The manifest declares every final release slot and distinguishes candidate foundation contents.

requirements.title: Release authority is non-ambiguous
requirements.acceptance_gate: Vault-owner and independent-technical approvals bind one digest to different canonical authenticated human principals and cannot be inferred or substituted.

requirements.title: The package is specification-only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only declared specification artifacts and the exact conformance executable inventory exist; no production boundary is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: Validator extensions are closed and version-bound
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only registered extension identifiers and their exact version-bound subject schemas are evaluated; ambient or undeclared validators are denied.

requirements.title: Every validation artifact shares one immutable version binding
requirements.acceptance_gate: Invocations, envelopes, claims, artifacts, receipts, recovery reports, and verdicts bind the current package and validator versions and recomputed artifact digests.

requirements.title: Evidence envelopes are deterministic and complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every envelope explicitly carries its requirement, subject, ordered digests and verified receipt bindings, execution context, and verdict with contiguous ordinals.

requirements.title: Claim manifests bind one claim to required evidence
requirements.acceptance_gate: Each of the eight isolated profiles has one closed manifest and independent digest binding from claim and requirement to evidence and verdict.

requirements.title: Verdict aggregation denies absent mandatory proof
requirements.acceptance_gate: Pass requires complete current mandatory proof; fail, unsupported, and inconclusive retain distinct non-pass semantics under the complete verdict table.

requirements.title: Readback and recovery preserve non-pass results
requirements.acceptance_gate: Readback recomputes every binding and fail, unsupported, or inconclusive remains effective until fresh mandatory evidence reopens evaluation through the complete lifecycle.

requirements.title: Validator evidence artifacts are specification-only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only specification, schemas, fixtures, validator assertions, traceability, and evidence artifacts are added; no production mdplace boundary is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: The canonical operation envelope is closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-SK identifiers and canonical vocabulary define every accepted append and replay record as one digest-bound immutable OperationCommit with identity, version, exact authority, bases, ordering, typed independently versioned events, idempotency, preconditions, and closure receipt; malformed, torn, noncanonical, unsupported, unknown, and digest-mismatched records are rejected atomically.

requirements.title: Compare-and-append is serialized and fail-closed
requirements.acceptance_gate: A closed scenario and operation schema, package-bound exact-tuple capability registry, and complete lifecycle table ensure an authorized exact-base command with a recomputed command digest, unique idempotency material, and a new operation identity against complete history emits one immutable canonical operation and receipt; stale, duplicate, incompatible, unauthorized, noncontiguous, failed-precondition, or illegal input emits one deterministic rejection and no semantic write.

requirements.title: Replay snapshots ordering and views are deterministic
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 30 manifest scenarios prove atomic ordered-event replay, operation fixity, legal and illegal removal, full replay and valid-snapshot suffix equivalence, stable ordering, recognized forward-compatible no-op behavior, and disposable view rebuild only from canonical history.

requirements.title: Stateful fixtures observe complete closure outcomes
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 30 manifest-owned stateful scenarios are classified by ID, path, subject kind, or schema with all four paired, cover every required class including removal, and expose accepted or rejected closure, canonical record or none, receipts, semantic state, snapshots or replay, rebuilt views, filesystem effects, terminal state, and illegal transitions.

requirements.title: Validation and evidence bind public behavior
requirements.acceptance_gate: The validator checks public schemas, closed receipts, lifecycle behavior, ordering, idempotency, replay, snapshots, rebuild, recovery, authority denials, traceability, and fixture/result-bound machine evidence without private implementation assertions.

requirements.title: The accepted reconciliation remains an input
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every Semantic Kernel requirement binds the exact accepted issue #2 decision as input_without_reopening and none restores a deprecated authority or persistence model.

requirements.title: Artifacts are specification and conformance only
requirements.acceptance_gate: Only specification, schemas, registries, fixtures, conformance-only observers, traceability, and evidence are added; no production mdplace boundary or vault mutation is implemented or invoked.

requirements.title: Stable requirements use canonical policy vocabulary
requirements.acceptance_gate: Stable REQ-CPP identifiers use only canonical vocabulary and distinguish Processing Policy permission, Source Profile approval, compatibility evidence, and semantic authority.

requirements.title: Processing Policy and Source Profile contracts are closed and complete
requirements.acceptance_gate: Closed policy, Source Profile, request, rule, receipt, scenario, lifecycle, and recovery contracts enumerate every version, grant, obligation, binding, authority, transition, and failure without ambient defaults.

requirements.title: Every ungranted or stale request is denied before effect
requirements.acceptance_gate: All absent, unknown, unpermitted, over-budget, over-retry, over-fallback, unredacted, retention-unproven, stale, hostile, or authority-widening requests deny before transmission, semantic operation, or filesystem effect.

requirements.title: Descendant policies narrow monotonically
requirements.acceptance_gate: Canary and policy-pair fixtures prove exact parent binding, preservation or reduction of every permission dimension, and deterministic denial of each attempted widening.

requirements.title: Source Profile approval and readback precede intake
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every intake decision follows nondelegated vault-owner approval and exact digest readback of all Source Profile bindings; absent, stale, mismatched, revoked, or compatibility-claim-substituted binding denies intake.

requirements.title: Fixtures and machine evidence prove public closure
requirements.acceptance_gate: Exactly 50 fixture and result digest bindings prove public inputs, decisions, receipts, filesystem effects, boundaries, stale states, policy pairs, illegal transitions, and recovery without private assertions.

requirements.title: Issue number 8 is not reopened and no production code is added
requirements.acceptance_gate: Every REQ-CPP record cites only the exact accepted issue #8 resolution as input_without_reopening and all additions remain specification and conformance artifacts with zero production or vault effects.
